links.outcome: AI glaucoma screening performance on out-of-distribution and low-quality images in real-world settings
links.effect: Performance decreases significantly in real-world scenarios due to out-of-distribution and low-quality images; the challenge tested robustness, with the top team reaching AUC 0.99 (95% CI 0.98-0.99) for detecting ungradable images.
links.quote: While AI models for glaucoma screening from CFPs have shown promising results in laboratory settings, their performance decreases significantly in real-world scenarios due to the presence of out-of-distribution and low-quality images.

screen.reason: Reports on the AIROGS machine learning challenge benchmarking glaucoma screening models specifically for robustness against out-of-distribution/ungradable fundus images.
